title: Light queue jobs ignore an explicit one-token reservation under dynamic CPU pressure
body: The runner test witness stayed queued for over 11 minutes with free=6 and cpu-pressure/run-queue; retrying with --cpu-tokens 1 still reported requested=default and granted=2. A short/light command needs a bounded admission path that honors its declared CPU width or bypasses stale p91 history without manual retries.

title: Full VIXEN build admission needs a manual low-parallelism override
body: The queued default cmake --build build/wsl was blocked at projected=32097MB plus reserve; retrying with explicit --parallel 2 is required to obtain a witness. The facade/build wrapper should derive a queue-safe parallelism or memory estimate automatically.
